text:
I can't say whether this asset is deforestation-free. The evidence is insufficient to answer either way.

The check for tree-cover loss on ASSET-K between 2021-01-01 and 2025-12-31 (after the 2020-12-31 baseline) wasn't carried out. The source coverage this asset needs hadn't been prepared, so no observation was made. Hansen Global Forest Change, JRC GFC2020 and MGAP 2021 were all unavailable for it.

This means the evidence doesn't show that no tree-cover loss occurred, and it doesn't show that loss did occur. It also gives no basis for any regulatory finding, such as EUDR compliant or non-compliant.

To get an answer, the missing source coverage would need to be prepared and the analysis re-run. This reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12.
